name: Zamja
summary: In Orgrimmar’s Drag, Zamja teaches Horde travelers to cook. The Darkspear troll trains cooks to make meals from beasts of Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Cleaver in the Drag
sections.body: Zamja works in the Drag, where she cuts meat and teaches Horde travelers to cook. Cooking helps travelers in the rugged lands of Durotar and the Barrens turn raw game into rations. Cooks who have mastered basic recipes can seek further training in Gadgetzan, to the south.

faq.answer: Zamja is a Darkspear troll cooking trainer in Orgrimmar’s Drag. She teaches Horde cooks and helps them improve their craft.
You can find Zamja in the Drag, the shaded trench that winds between Orgrimmar’s Valley of Strength and Valley of Honor.
Zamja teaches cooking and recipes for preparing food from beasts and game gathered across Kalimdor. Cooks ready for further training can seek more advanced instructors.

faq.q: Where does Zamja send advanced cooks?
faq.answer: When a cook outgrows the training available in Orgrimmar, Zamja directs them to Gadgetzan in Tanaris to find Dirge Quikcleave.

angles.text: Zamja is one of the main cooking trainers for Horde characters in Orgrimmar. She teaches essential recipes and directs experienced cooks south to Tanaris for advanced instruction.
Like many Darkspear trolls, Zamja has settled in Orgrimmar under Warchief Thrall’s banner. She brings troll resourcefulness and culinary craft to the Horde capital.
